title: 公共教育投入、家庭人力资本投资与生育决策
title_zh: 公共教育投入、家庭人力资本投资与生育决策
title_primary: 公共教育投入、家庭人力资本投资与生育决策
authors: 罗楚亮, 刘盼
official: 官方发布 2026-07-10 · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: 教育机会对家庭生育、教育行为和收入不平等具有重要影响。本文在世代交叠模型中引入公共教育资源分配不均等，内生化异质性家庭的生育与教育决策，考察公共教育投入对家庭人力资本投资、生育行为以及收入分配的影响。研究发现：公共教育投入增加对家庭私人教育投资及子女陪伴时间具有替代效应，通过降低养育成本提高总和生育率；公共教育均等化则有效提高了低人力资本家庭的公共教育资源可及性，显著降低收入不平等。此外，降低养育时间成本和树立积极生育观对提高总和生育率也具有重要影响。
abstract_zh: 教育机会对家庭生育、教育行为和收入不平等具有重要影响。本文在世代交叠模型中引入公共教育资源分配不均等，内生化异质性家庭的生育与教育决策，考察公共教育投入对家庭人力资本投资、生育行为以及收入分配的影响。研究发现：公共教育投入增加对家庭私人教育投资及子女陪伴时间具有替代效应，通过降低养育成本提高总和生育率；公共教育均等化则有效提高了低人力资本家庭的公共教育资源可及性，显著降低收入不平等。此外，降低养育时间成本和树立积极生育观对提高总和生育率也具有重要影响。

title: Fiscal Distress and Banking Performance: The Role of Macroprudential Regulation
title_zh: 财政困境与银行业绩：宏观审慎监管的作用
title_primary: 财政困境与银行业绩：宏观审慎监管的作用
title_secondary: Fiscal Distress and Banking Performance: The Role of Macroprudential Regulation
authors: HIONA BALFOUSSIA, HARRIS DELLAS, DIMITRIS PAPAGEORGIOU
source: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
official: 官方在线 2026-07-28 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Fiscal fragility undermines a government's ability to honor its bank deposit insurance pledge and induces a positive correlation between sovereign default risk and financial (bank) default risk. We show that this positive relation is reversed if bank capital requirements in fiscally weak countries are allowed to adjust optimally. The resulting higher requirements buttress the banking system and support higher output and welfare relative to the case where macroprudential policy does not vary with the degree of fiscal stress. Fiscal tenuousness also exacerbates the effects of other risk shocks. Nonetheless, the economy's response can be mitigated if macroprudential policy is adjusted optimally.
abstract_zh: 财政脆弱性削弱了政府履行银行存款保险承诺的能力，并导致主权违约风险与金融（银行）违约风险之间呈现正相关关系。我们证明，若允许财政薄弱国家的银行资本要求进行最优调整，这种正相关关系将发生逆转。相较于宏观审慎政策不随财政压力程度变化的情形，由此产生的更高资本要求能够强化银行体系，并支撑更高的产出与福利水平。财政脆弱性还会加剧其他风险冲击的影响。然而，若对宏观审慎政策进行最优调整，经济对此类冲击的反应可得到缓解。

title: The Ins & Outs of Chinese Monetary Policy Transmission
title_zh: 中国货币政策传导的来龙去脉
title_primary: 中国货币政策传导的来龙去脉
title_secondary: The Ins & Outs of Chinese Monetary Policy Transmission
authors: Miranda-Agrippino, Silvia, Nenova, Tsvetelina, Rey, Helene
official: 官方在线 2026-07-20 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Using a novel indicator for the People's Bank of China monetary policy stance, we estimate a policy rule that accounts for the dual nature of its price stability mandate-encompassing domestic inflation and the exchange rate-and for the evolution of its operational framework. The Ins: The domestic transmission follows textbook patterns, with exceptions due to the active management of the renminbi and the financial account. The Outs: International spillovers are powerful and affect commodity markets, global production and trade. The pass-through to foreign (US) prices is substantial. Financial spillovers are second-order, and mostly derivative from trade spillovers.
abstract_zh: 我们采用一项衡量中国人民银行货币政策立场的新指标，估算了一条政策规则，该规则既考虑了其价格稳定目标的双重属性——涵盖国内通胀与汇率——也考虑了其操作框架的演变。内部传导方面：遵循教科书模式，但由于人民币和金融账户的积极管理而存在例外。外部溢出方面：国际溢出效应显著，影响大宗商品市场、全球生产与贸易。对国外（美国）价格的传导效应相当大。金融溢出效应属于次要层面，主要源于贸易溢出效应。

title: Work Intensity and Welfare Across Countries and Over Time
title_zh: 跨国与跨时期的工作强度与福利
title_primary: 跨国与跨时期的工作强度与福利
title_secondary: Work Intensity and Welfare Across Countries and Over Time
authors: Francisco Alcalá, Margherita Borella, Mariacristina De Nardi, Fang Yang, Johanna Torres Chain 等
official: 官方在线 2025-10-02 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper develops a long-run theory of labor effort, defined as the product of hours worked times work intensity. Under empirically plausible parameter values, the model predicts that intensity rises with income as hours decline. The theory provides a unified interpretation of several empirical regularities: cross-country disparities in hourly productivity among workers with comparable skills and technologies; higher workplace stress in richer economies; limited effectiveness of work-organization reforms in poor regions; patterns of non-work at work. The model is calibrated to match the large joint shift in hours and work intensity in the United States during the first half of the twentieth century. It shows that cross-country differences in intensity matter for welfare as much as differences in hours and suggests that accounting for intensity would significantly narrow measured welfare differences between rich and poor countries. The analysis identifies a key mechanism underlying the reorganization of work and leisure during the transition from poor traditional economies to affluent industrial ones.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个关于劳动努力的长期理论，将劳动努力定义为工作时间与工作强度的乘积。在经验上合理的参数取值下，模型预测工作强度随收入上升而增加，而工作时间则随之下降。该理论为若干经验规律提供了统一解释：技能与技术条件相似的劳动者在小时生产率上存在的跨国差异；富裕经济体中更高的工作场所压力；贫困地区工作组织改革的有限成效；以及“在职非工作”的行为模式。模型经过校准，以匹配20世纪上半叶美国工作时间和工作强度的大幅联合变动。研究表明，跨国工作强度差异对福利的影响与工作时间差异同等重要，并指出若将工作强度纳入考量，将显著缩小富国与穷国之间测度上的福利差距。分析揭示了从贫困传统经济向富裕工业经济转型过程中，工作与休闲重组背后的关键机制。

title: Attracting and Retaining Highly Effective Educators in Hard-to-Staff Schools
title_zh: 吸引并留住难以配备师资学校中的高效教育工作者
title_primary: 吸引并留住难以配备师资学校中的高效教育工作者
title_secondary: Attracting and Retaining Highly Effective Educators in Hard-to-Staff Schools
authors: Morgan, Andrew, Nguyen, Minh, Hanushek, Eric, Ost, Ben, Rivkin, Steven
official: 卷期日期 2026-08-01 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Attracting and retaining effective teachers in high-poverty schools remains a persistent challenge. We evaluate the impact of an initiative that offered substantial performance-based compensation to highly effective teachers in the lowest-achieving schools. We find that the program led to dramatic improvements in achievement, nearly closing the gap between the targeted schools and the district average. When the program was later reversed for some campuses, effective teachers departed at high rates, resulting in an immediate decline in student achievement. The results underscore the potential for effectiveness-based compensating differentials to attract and retain effective teachers in disadvantaged schools.
abstract_zh: 在贫困率较高的学校中吸引并留住高效教师仍是一项长期挑战。我们评估了一项针对成绩最差学校中高效教师提供高额绩效薪酬的举措。研究发现，该项目显著提升了学生学业成绩，几乎弥合了目标学校与学区平均水平之间的差距。当该项目后来在部分学校被取消时，高效教师大量流失，导致学生成绩立即下滑。研究结果凸显了基于教学效能的薪酬差异在吸引和留住弱势学校高效教师方面的潜力。

title: The Benefits from Bundling Demand in K-12 Broadband Procurement
title_zh: K-12宽带采购中捆绑需求带来的收益
title_primary: K-12宽带采购中捆绑需求带来的收益
title_secondary: The Benefits from Bundling Demand in K-12 Broadband Procurement
authors: Aryal, Gaurab, Pal, Pallavi, Murry, Charles, Palit, Arnab
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We study a new market design for K-12 broadband procurement that switched from school-specific bidding to a system that bundled schools into groups. Using an event study approach, we estimate that this program reduced internet prices by $9.17 (55%) per Mbps per month while increasing bandwidth by 380.06 Mbps (136%). These benefits resulted primarily from mitigating exposure risk—the possibility that providers win too few contracts to cover their fixed infrastructure costs. We document participants’ potential savings of $1.61–$3.48 million relative to their $2.47 million E-rate subsidy.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了一种面向K-12宽带采购的新市场设计，该设计将原本按学校单独招标的模式转变为将学校捆绑成组的系统。通过事件研究方法，我们估计该计划使每Mbps月均互联网价格降低了9.17美元（降幅55%），同时带宽增加了380.06 Mbps（增幅136%）。这些收益主要源于缓解了暴露风险——即供应商可能因赢得合同数量过少而无法覆盖其固定基础设施成本的可能性。我们记录到，参与者相对于其247万美元的E-rate补贴，潜在节省金额为161万至348万美元。

title: Opening the black box of Europe’s new fiscal rules
title_zh: 揭开欧洲新财政规则的黑箱
title_primary: 揭开欧洲新财政规则的黑箱
title_secondary: Opening the black box of Europe’s new fiscal rules
authors: Daniel Gros, Silvan Hofer
official: 官方在线 2026-07-15 · 来源：RSS
abstract: The EU's fiscal rules in force since 2024 are often criticised for their complexity. The official implementation requires thousands of lines of code and a sophisticated debt sustainability analysis. This column argues that the central result can be approximated by a remarkably simple formula: the required primary balance equals the largest debt-stabilising primary balance in a ten-year period plus roughly 1% of the debt ratio. While this simplification cannot replace the full calculations, it helps demystify the debt rules and provides a shortcut for assessing the impact of policies on debt sustainability.
abstract_zh: 自2024年起生效的欧盟财政规则常因其复杂性而受到批评。官方实施需要数千行代码和复杂的债务可持续性分析。本文认为，其核心结果可通过一个极为简单的公式近似得出：所需的基本财政余额等于十年期内最大的债务稳定基本余额加上约1%的债务比率。尽管这一简化无法替代完整计算，但它有助于揭开债务规则的神秘面纱，并为评估政策对债务可持续性的影响提供了一条捷径。

title: Identifying News Shocks From Forecasts
title_zh: 从预测中识别新闻冲击
title_primary: 从预测中识别新闻冲击
title_secondary: Identifying News Shocks From Forecasts
authors: Jonathan J. Adams, Philip Barrett
official: 官方在线 2026-07-09 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We propose a method to identify the anticipated components of macroeconomic shocks in a structural VAR. We include empirical forecasts about each time series in the VAR. This introduces enough linear restrictions to identify every structural shock and to further decompose each one into “news” and “surprise” shocks. We estimate a VAR on U.S. time series using forecast data from the SPF, CBO, Federal Reserve, and asset prices. Unanticipated fiscal stimulus and monetary policy shocks have typical effects that match existing evidence. In our news‐surprise decomposition, we find that news drives around one quarter of U.S. business cycle volatility. News explains a larger share of the variance due to fiscal shocks than for monetary policy shocks. Finally, we use the news structure of the shocks to estimate counterfactual policy rules, and compare the ability of fiscal and monetary policy to moderate output and inflation. We find that coordinated fiscal and monetary policy are substantially more effective than either individually.
abstract_zh: 摘要 本文提出一种在结构向量自回归（VAR）中识别宏观经济冲击预期成分的方法。我们将各时间序列的经验预测纳入VAR模型，由此引入足够的线性约束，从而识别所有结构性冲击，并进一步将每个冲击分解为“新闻”冲击与“意外”冲击。我们利用美国国会预算办公室（CBO）、美联储、资产价格及专业预测者调查（SPF）的预测数据，对美国时间序列进行VAR估计。研究发现，未预期的财政刺激与货币政策冲击的典型效应与既有证据一致。在新闻-意外分解中，新闻冲击解释了美国经济周期波动约四分之一的方差。相较于货币政策冲击，新闻冲击对财政冲击方差的解释份额更大。最后，我们利用冲击的新闻结构估计反事实政策规则，并比较财政政策与货币政策在平抑产出与通胀方面的效力。结果表明，财政与货币政策的协调配合比单一政策显著更有效。

title: Racial Disparities in Education During and Following the Pandemic: Evidence in Connecticut through 2025
title_zh: 疫情期间及之后教育中的种族差异：基于康涅狄格州截至2025年的证据
title_primary: 疫情期间及之后教育中的种族差异：基于康涅狄格州截至2025年的证据
title_secondary: Racial Disparities in Education During and Following the Pandemic: Evidence in Connecticut through 2025
authors: Eric Brunner, Stephen Ross, Xinrui Wang
official: 官方在线 2026-07-02 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We examine pandemic related racial and ethnic disparities in test scores, absenteeism, and disciplinary incidents for K-12 students in the State of Connecticut through the 2024-25 school year. Notably, most existing pandemic studies only cover absenteeism through 2022-23, and minimal quantitative evidence exists on the post-pandemic incidence of student discipline related behaviors. Consistent with prior studies, we find persistent negative effects of the pandemic on test scores, as well as substantial disparities in test scores along racial and ethnic lines. For middle school, we also find persistent post-pandemic increases in both severe disciplinary incidents overall and racial and ethnic disparities in severe discipline incidents. However, we document substantial recovery in racial and ethnic disparities in attendance rates and chronic absenteeism by 2024-25. For all outcomes, most of the increases in disparities are associated with Black and Latinx students attending schools that had worse pre-pandemic outcomes and higher pre-pandemic shares of students who are either economically disadvantaged or face learning barriers.
abstract_zh: 我们考察了康涅狄格州K-12学生截至2024-25学年的疫情相关种族与族裔差异，涵盖考试成绩、缺勤率及违纪事件。值得注意的是，现有疫情研究大多仅覆盖至2022-23学年的缺勤数据，且关于疫情后学生违纪行为发生率的量化证据极为有限。与既往研究一致，我们发现疫情对考试成绩存在持续性负面影响，且考试成绩在种族与族裔维度上呈现显著差异。在中学阶段，我们还发现疫情后严重违纪事件总体发生率以及种族与族裔间严重违纪事件差异均持续扩大。然而，到2024-25学年，出勤率与长期缺勤率方面的种族与族裔差异已出现显著恢复。就所有结果而言，差异扩大的主要原因是黑人与拉丁裔学生就读的学校在疫情前已存在更差的表现，且这些学校中经济弱势或面临学习障碍的学生比例在疫情前就更高。

title: Do China's State‐Owned Enterprises Promote Their Suppliers' Participation in Global Value Chains?
title_zh: 中国国有企业是否促进了其供应商参与全球价值链？
title_primary: 中国国有企业是否促进了其供应商参与全球价值链？
title_secondary: Do China's State‐Owned Enterprises Promote Their Suppliers' Participation in Global Value Chains?
authors: Yongming Huang, Xin Li
official: 官方在线 2026-07-04 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Chinese state‐owned enterprises (SOEs) serve as critical institutional anchors in supply chains. Utilising panel data from 1076 Chinese A‐share listed firms during the period of 2008–2016, this study examines the impact of SOEs on global value chain (GVC) participation of their suppliers. The empirical results from difference‐in‐differences method demonstrate that SOEs significantly enhance their suppliers' GVC participation. Mechanism tests reveal that SOEs boost their suppliers' GVC participation through operational enhancements, supply chain efficiency and FDI attraction improvements. In addition, this study identifies that resource misallocation and coordination costs negatively moderate the effect of SOEs on their suppliers' GVC participation. Heterogeneity analyses reveal that the positive effects of SOEs are stronger for large suppliers and those suppliers without micro and small enterprises (MSEs) as major customers. Notably, SOEs enhance the intensive‐margin of GVCs but have a negligible effect on the extensive‐margin. These findings position SOEs as catalysts for GVC participation, offering policy insights for other economies with SOEs.
abstract_zh: 中国国有企业在供应链中扮演着关键的制度锚点角色。本研究利用2008-2016年间1076家中国A股上市公司的面板数据，考察国有企业对其供应商全球价值链参与度的影响。基于双重差分法的实证结果表明，国有企业显著提升了其供应商的全球价值链参与度。机制检验显示，国有企业通过运营优化、供应链效率提升以及外商直接投资吸引力增强等途径，促进了供应商的全球价值链参与。此外，本研究发现资源错配与协调成本会负向调节国有企业对供应商全球价值链参与度的促进作用。异质性分析表明，对于大型供应商以及不以微型和小型企业为主要客户的供应商而言，国有企业的正向效应更为显著。值得注意的是，国有企业主要强化了全球价值链的集约边际，而对扩展边际的影响微乎其微。这些发现将国有企业定位为全球价值链参与的催化剂，为其他拥有国有企业的经济体提供了政策启示。

title: The Life Cycle Implications of Temporary Employment Contracts
title_zh: 临时雇佣合同的生命周期影响
title_primary: 临时雇佣合同的生命周期影响
title_secondary: The Life Cycle Implications of Temporary Employment Contracts
authors: Rosemary Kaiser
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Employment protections often create two-tiered labor markets with substantial differences in job security. I estimate the effects of removing these protections using a quantitative life cycle model, where younger workers are more likely to select into precarious jobs. Workers accumulate human capital when employed and face the possibility of human capital losses in unemployment. Because workers with greater job security experience fewer unemployment spells, they tend to accumulate more human capital over their careers. I show that reducing employment protections boosts younger workers’ job-finding rates but lowers human capital, GDP, and employment. Impacts of these policies differ significantly by age. (JEL D15, E23, E24, J22, J24, J41, J42)
abstract_zh: 就业保护往往导致劳动力市场出现两级分化，不同岗位的工作保障程度差异显著。本文通过构建量化生命周期模型，评估了取消这些保护措施的经济效应。在该模型中，年轻劳动者更倾向于选择不稳定的工作岗位。劳动者在就业期间积累人力资本，而失业则面临人力资本贬损的风险。由于工作保障程度较高的劳动者经历失业的次数更少，其职业生涯中积累的人力资本往往更多。研究表明：降低就业保护虽能提升年轻劳动者的就业率，但会降低人力资本存量、国内生产总值及整体就业水平。这些政策对不同年龄段劳动者的影响存在显著差异。（JEL分类号：D15, E23, E24, J22, J24, J41, J42）

title: Getting There and Getting In: How Mobility and Sorting Keep Women out of Top Startup Accelerators
title_zh: 到达与进入：流动性与分类如何将女性排除在顶级创业加速器之外
title_primary: 到达与进入：流动性与分类如何将女性排除在顶级创业加速器之外
title_secondary: Getting There and Getting In: How Mobility and Sorting Keep Women out of Top Startup Accelerators
authors: Chuan Chen, Michele Fioretti, Junnan He, Yanrong Jia
official: 官方在线 2026-06-22 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Startup accelerators are a leading gateway to venture capital, but top programs often require founders to relocate to a venture hub. From a hand-collected census of U.S. accelerator startups (2008-2011) followed for five years, we estimate a two-sided matching model that separates two channels behind the gender funding gap, geographic mobility and sorting across accelerator tiers. Women raise about 60% less than men over five years; the gap concentrates among non-relocating women, is largest at active-childrearing ages, and vanishes for relocators, while the mobility cost is near zero for men. Removing mobility frictions raises women's match quality but not their tier; reaching the high-funding top tier also requires removing the sorting disadvantage that women face. The 2012 JOBS Act eased the legal barrier and capacity grew tenfold, yet the U.S. VC dollar gap still tripled (2011-2020): closing it needs mobility, sorting, and capacity together.
abstract_zh: 创业加速器是通往风险资本的主要门户，但顶级项目通常要求创始人迁至创业中心。基于一项手工收集的美国加速器初创企业普查数据（2008-2011年，追踪五年），我们估计了一个双边匹配模型，以分离性别融资差距背后的两个渠道：地理流动性和加速器层级的分类效应。五年间，女性融资额比男性低约60%；这一差距集中在未迁址的女性群体中，在育儿活跃年龄段最大，而迁址女性的差距消失，同时男性的流动性成本几乎为零。消除流动性摩擦可提高女性的匹配质量，但无法提升其层级；要进入高融资的顶级层级，还需消除女性面临的分类劣势。2012年《创业企业扶助法》降低了法律障碍，加速器容量增长了十倍，但美国风险资本美元差距仍扩大了两倍（2011-2020年）：缩小这一差距需要同时解决流动性、分类和容量问题。

title: Pretend or Amend? On Evergreening in CRE
title_zh: 联邦储备系统理事会
title_primary: 联邦储备系统理事会
title_secondary: Pretend or Amend? On Evergreening in CRE
authors: David Glancy
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Loan modifications can either amplify or mitigate credit losses depending on the strategy lenders employ. Using detailed supervisory data and a model incorporating various frictions that could encourage modifications (liquidity constraints, foreclosure costs, and loss recognition costs), I assess why banks extend CRE loans. I find that extensions predominantly address temporary payment frictions, both in normal times and following the Spring 2023 bank stress episode. Contrary to concerns about banks “extending-and-pretending” following that episode, banks increased income and principal paydown requirements for extensions, contributing to strong ex-post performance for extended loans.
abstract_zh: 贷款修改可能放大或减轻信用损失，具体取决于贷款机构采用的策略。利用详细的监管数据以及一个纳入可能促使修改的各种摩擦因素（流动性约束、止赎成本和损失确认成本）的模型，我评估了银行发放商业房地产贷款的原因。我发现，无论是在正常时期还是在2023年春季银行压力事件之后，展期主要都是为了解决临时性支付摩擦。与对该事件后银行“展期并假装”的担忧相反，银行提高了展期贷款的收入和本金偿还要求，从而使得展期贷款在事后表现出强劲的业绩。

title: Trade War and Technology Rivalry
title_zh: 贸易战与技术竞争
title_primary: 贸易战与技术竞争
title_secondary: Trade War and Technology Rivalry
authors: Ma, Xiao, Wang, Zi, Zhu, Xiaodong
official: 官方在线 2026-06-11 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We develop a dynamic multi-country trade model with trade-related technology diffusion and endogenous R&D to quantify the impacts of trade policies and trade wars on innovation, technology rivalry, and welfare. We estimate the model using data on trade and patent citations and validate it in the context of U.S. export controls on China. Counterfactual analysis yields three main results. First, U.S. export controls on China reduce technological progress in both countries: China experiences a sharp contraction in knowledge inflows, while the U.S. faces a decline in R&D. Second, trade-driven diffusion and endogenous innovation substantially amplify the technological and welfare gains in the U.S. and losses in other major economies from the 2025 Liberation Day tariffs. Third, U.S. optimal tariffs on China, under varying geopolitical concerns, reflect a trade-off between curbing technology diffusion to China and sustaining U.S. innovation.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个包含贸易驱动技术扩散与内生研发的动态多国贸易模型，用以量化贸易政策及贸易战对创新、技术竞争和福利的影响。基于贸易与专利引用数据对模型进行估计，并以美国对华出口管制为背景验证模型有效性。反事实分析得出三项主要结论：第一，美国对华出口管制将抑制两国技术进步——中国面临知识流入急剧收缩，而美国则遭遇研发活动衰退；第二，贸易驱动的技术扩散与内生创新机制显著放大了2025年解放日关税对美国的技术与福利增益，同时加剧其他主要经济体的损失；第三，在不同地缘政治关切下，美国对华最优关税体现了遏制技术向中国扩散与维持美国创新活力之间的权衡。

title: Thematic Concentration and Mutual Fund Performance
title_zh: 主题集中度与共同基金业绩
title_primary: 主题集中度与共同基金业绩
title_secondary: Thematic Concentration and Mutual Fund Performance
authors: John (Jianqiu) Bai, Yuehua Tang, Chi Wan, Zafer Yuksel
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-03 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This study examines whether mutual fund managers generate alpha through thematic investment strategies that select stocks poised to benefit from specific themes. Using textual analysis of 10-K filings, we identify stocks’ thematic exposures and construct each fund’s thematic concentration index (TCI) from its holdings. High-TCI funds significantly outperform, with a top-minus-bottom decile spread of 4.26% in annualized four-factor alpha. Managers’ thematic expertise is related to their undergraduate field of study. Outperformance arises from superior stock selection rather than theme-related timing, with an informational advantage on firm earnings, particularly in stocks exposed to themes related to managers’ undergraduate training.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了共同基金经理是否通过主题投资策略（即选择有望从特定主题中受益的股票）创造超额收益。通过对10-K文件进行文本分析，我们识别出股票的主题暴露程度，并根据基金持仓构建了各基金的主题集中指数（TCI）。高TCI基金的表现显著优于其他基金，其最高与最低十分位组合的年化四因子阿尔法差值为4.26%。基金经理的主题专长与其本科专业领域相关。超额收益源于卓越的选股能力而非主题相关时机选择，且这种优势体现在对公司盈利的信息优势上，尤其当股票暴露的主题与基金经理本科专业背景相关时更为显著。
